verdict.rationale: Brex documents category/merchant/amount-based spend controls via Budgets/Spend Limits API and policy rules that are auto-enforced on every transaction, plus configurable card limits — matching the core of the story. However, no direct evidence of point-of-sale real-time decline/lock behavior or explicit merchant-category-code restriction language, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the enforcement working as described. Missing for 10: explicit point-of-sale auto-decline/lock documentation, merchant-category-specific control detail, third-party validation of enforcement.
